svg.text: Provider-neutral planning, capacity and governance workspace.
Decisions remain explainable because planning intent and provider execution stay separate.
Estimate ≠ commitment · Demand ≠ allocation · Forecast ≠ baseline
A focused workspace for planning, delivery and governance.

g.text: Facts stay separate; derived signals retain basis and provenance.

svg.text: Planning facts remain different objects with clear semantics and lineage.
The model protects meaning, not just rows.

g.text: planned effort can change without rewriting the commitment
resource demand stays independent from who is actually allocated
current forecast may move while the approved baseline stays frozen
no evidence never becomes a fake green status or numeric zero
provider facts are imported without surrendering planner semantics

svg.text: From planning to delivery, with the right artifacts in the right places.

g.text: teams · capacity · utilization · planned vs actual
members · mappings · access · developer API · capability registry

svg.text: Source facts become decisions without losing lineage.
Design decisions that make planning reliable and useful.

g.text: modular monolith until evidence says otherwise
